Requirement 1.3/S1 (Introduction > Project Scope):
This Video Searching software will be a system that uses an active internet connection to search multiple websites for streaming videos or torrents.
results.lean_predicate:
structure Input where
  query  : String
  websites : List String
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

structure Output where
  videos  : List String
  torrents : List String
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def Spec : Contract Input Output where
  pre  := fun i => i.query ≠ "" ∧ i.websites.Nodup
  post := fun i o => o.videos.Nodup ∧ o.torrents.Nodup ∧
                     (o.videos = i.websites.map (fun w => w ++ "/video?q=" ++ i.query)) ∧
                     (o.torrents = i.websites.map (fun w => w ++ "/torrent?q=" ++ i.query))

example : Spec.pre { query := "example", websites := ["website1.com", "website2.com"] } ∧
          Spec.post { query := "example", websites := ["website1.com", "website2.com"] }
                    { videos := ["website1.com/video?q=example", "website2.com/video?q=example"],
                      torrents := ["website1.com/torrent?q=example", "website2.com/torrent?q=example"] } := by
  unfold Spec; decide
results.bad_example:
example : Spec.pre { query := "example", websites := ["www.site1.com", "www.site2.com"] } ∧ ¬ Spec.post { query := "example", websites := ["www.site1.com", "www.site2.com"] } { videos := [], torrents := [] } := by
  unfold Spec; decide

structure Video where
  name      : String
  length    : Nat
  datePosted: Nat  -- in days since epoch
  link      : String
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

structure Input where
  siteName  : String
  query     : String
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

structure Output where
  found     : Bool
  videos    : List Video
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

  pre  := fun i => i.siteName ≠ "" ∧ i.query ≠ ""
  post := fun i o => o.found ↔
    ∃ v ∈ o.videos, v.name = i.query ∧
    o.videos.length > 0 ∧
    ∀ v ∈ o.videos, v.name ≠ "" ∧ 0 < v.length ∧ 0 ≤ v.datePosted ∧ v.link ≠ ""
